insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 37% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 20% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +9% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (155) vs Lululemon (171). Gap of 16 to close.
Leggings opportunity: Lululemon has 203 vs Vuori's 171. Gap of 32 SKUs.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 45% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1438 vs 1215 products. A 18% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 662 products. Behind Gymshark (1294).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 512 products vs Lululemon's 622. Key for cooler weather expansion.
